originalTitle: Police investigating Ann Widdecombe murder reopen attempted burglary case from 2025
summary: Failure to pursue line of inquiry ‘which may have been relevant’ now being investigated by police watchdog
content: Counter-terrorism police investigating the death of Ann Widdecombe say they have reopened an old investigation into an attempted burglary last year. The incident at an address in Greater London was reported in April 2025. Since the case was reopened, CTP London said it had identified a line of inquiry “which may have been relevant” but was “not identified and pursued by [counter-terrorism police] at the time”. The police watchdog said it is now investigating the conduct of a CTP London staff member over allegations they “failed to identify and pursue a line of inquiry” related to the attempted burglary. Vicki Evans, senior national coordinator for counter-terrorism policing, said: “As part of the ongoing investigation led by counter-terrorism policing south-east into the murder of Ann Widdecombe, officers have reopened an investigation into an incident reported to police last year.” CTP London made a “mandatory conduct referral” to the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC) on Friday. A spokesperson for the IOPC said: “We can confirm that the IOPC has decided to independently investigate the conduct of a counter-terrorism policing London staff member following a referral received earlier today. “The conduct relates to an allegation the individual failed to identify and pursue a line of inquiry relating to an attempted burglary reported in April 2025. “Counter-terrorism policing London has been notified of our decision, and no further information is available at this early stage.” Widdecombe, 78, a former Conservative minister, was found dead on 9 July at her home in Haytor on Dartmoor, Devon, having sustained serious injuries. Last month, a 28-year-old man was charged with the former MP’s murder. Joshua Kerry, from Rotherham in South Yorkshire, was arrested on suspicion of murder on 11 July. He was also arrested on suspicion of the commission, preparation or instigation of acts of terrorism but has not been charged with this offence. Devon and Cornwall police initially arrested a 26-year-old man from Newton Abbot in Devon, but later released him and said he was no longer part of the investigation. Widdecombe served as Conservative MP for Maidstone, Kent for 23 years. She subsequently represented south-west England as a member of the European parliament for the Brexit party and in 2023 joined Reform UK as a party spokesperson.
chineseTitle: 调查 Ann Widdecombe 谋杀案的警方从 2025 年起重新审理未遂入室盗窃案
chineseSummary: 未能进行“可能相关”的调查，目前正在接受警方监管机构的调查
chineseContent: 调查安·维德科姆死亡事件的反恐警察表示，他们已重新启动对去年一起未遂入室盗窃案的调查。 2025 年 4 月报道了发生在大伦敦一处地址的事件。自案件重新审理以来，CTP London 表示已确定了一条“可能相关”的调查线索，但“当时[反恐警察]并未发现并追查”。警方监管机构表示，目前正在调查伦敦 CTP 一名工作人员的行为，指控他们“未能识别并进行与未遂入室盗窃相关的调查”。国家反恐警务高级协调员维琪·埃文斯 (Vicki Evans) 表示：“作为东南部反恐警务部门对安·维德科姆谋杀案正在进行的调查的一部分，警方已重新开始对去年向警方报告的一起事件进行调查。”周五，CTP London 向警察行为独立办公室 (IOPC) 提出了“强制行为转介”。 IOPC 的一位发言人表示：“我们可以确认，在今天早些时候收到转介后，IOPC 已决定对一名伦敦反恐警务人员的行为进行独立调查。该行为涉及到一项指控，该人员未能识别并针对 2025 年 4 月报告的一起未遂入室盗窃案进行​​调查。伦敦反恐警务人员已收到我们的决定通知，目前尚无进一步信息。” 78 岁的维德科姆是前保守党部长，7 月 9 日被发现死在德文郡达特穆尔海托的家中，身受重伤。上个月，一名 28 岁男子被指控谋杀前议员。来自南约克郡罗瑟勒姆的约书亚·克里（Joshua Kerry）因涉嫌犯罪被捕
